name: IMAP Email Read Pattern
description: Read emails from IMAP server (Gmail, Outlook, Zoho, etc.)
explanation:
Pattern for reading emails from IMAP server.

Key settings:
- action: 'read' (fetch unread emails)
- folder: 'INBOX' (default folder)
- maxEmails: Number of emails to fetch (default: 10)
- onlyUnseen: true (fetch only unread emails)

Result stored in context.imapResult:
- emails: Array of email objects
- each email has: uid, from, to, subject, date, body, attachments

Supported providers:
- Gmail (use App Password)
- Outlook/Office 365
- Zoho Mail
- Any IMAP server

Setup: Configure IMAP connection in Connections settings.
